newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close steady, demand thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close steady, demand thin.

text.p: Rubber futures ended steady on Friday in moderate trade marked by buying for RSS3 and TSR20 rubber, dealers said.
"It's a very difficult market at the moment. The volumes being done are just for spot delivery and not very inspiring," a trader for a foreign brokerage house said.
Another dealer said Japan was not giving any inspiration to the local market because volumes in Tokyo and Kobe were thin.
"The funds in Japan have moved to other commodities. Their volume is not that heavy. The Japanese market is not giving any direction to the local market," a dealer said.

Most of the action was focused on RSS3 rubber, with total trades reaching almost 5,000 tonnes. Of that amount, around 3,300 tonnes were for spot May delivery. Trades for TSR20 rubber exceeded 3,000 tonnes, dealers said.
At around 0945 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 123.00-125.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.25 cents.
June RSS1 was seen at 177.00-179.00 Singapore cents (US$1.23-$1.25) a kg from 176.75 cents.
May TSR20 was seen at 166.50-168.50 Singapore cents (US$1.16-$1.18) a kg from the previous 167.25 cents.
